about_the_game:
F12 ➡ Push Notification ➡ Share – Quick and easy, every time!

Your Steam Screenshots, Instantly Mobile.

Steamshot makes it easier than ever to enjoy and share your Steam screenshots on the go! Whenever you take a new screenshot on Steam, Steamshot instantly transfers it to your Android phone [iOS version is in the works!], complete with a push notification. From there, you can quickly share your latest captures with friends or save them to your gallery.

Seamless Screenshot Sync for Gamers.

Steamshot also includes a range of convenient tools to help you organize and view your Steam screenshots directly from your phone. Simply download the free Android App and the Companion Desktop App from the official Steam App Store. Once both apps are connected to the same Wi-Fi network, you’re ready to go!

Game Screenshots, Without the Hassle.

   

You are safe!

  • No data is transferred from your computer

  • Your data is not shared or synchronized with any remote storage or third-party service

  • We do not have access to your personal data created in this application

Steamshot will run as a simple and small system tray application, with a neglectable memory and performance impact.

Important:

Steamshot works with both a PC/Desktop app and an Android mobile app – make sure you’ve got both installed for full functionality!

Please note:

The current version of Steamshot will shortly display a Harman / AIR Splash icon when it starts up.

(I'm planing to remove this icon in one of the next updates of the application.)
